identification: Signature reads HENK LEURS (Lot title says Hank). Likely Hendrik Johannes Henk Leurs (The Hague 1890-1956), post-Hague School impressionist, son of Johannes Karel Leurs. Small oil on canvas/board, snowy Dutch farm scene with figure, gilt frame. Plausibly genuine period Dutch work but a modest, low-value artist.
